scope: Implement and fast-test target-version gating and source-handle remapping for the low-level typed DXF MLEADERSTYLE writer.

implementation.minimumTarget: AC1021 / R2007; earlier target is rejected before output.

versionedFields.group179: Emitted only for AC1024 / R2010 and later.
versionedFields.group298: Emitted only for AC1027 / R2013 and later.

implementation.handlePolicy: Remap the record's own handle, owner and nonzero group 340-343 references before output.
implementation.nullPolicy: Zero is DRW::NoHandle and the absent/null reference value here; optional zero references are omitted. A nonzero reference mapped to zero is refused before record publication.
implementation.graphBoundary: Target kind, uniqueness and dangling-reference validation remain the adapter's rooted graph responsibility and are not implemented by this slice.

generatedControls: ASCII/binary AC1021, AC1024 and AC1027 target-version checks
zero optional arrowhead and block references omitted while 340/342 resolve
each nonzero 340-343 source reference mapped to zero refused before publication

evidenceLimits.referenceTargetKindAndUniqueness: not validated by this low-level writer slice
